title: Ten years, v
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (Ten Years Under the Table · deepening)
logline: Friday. Under the table. The 1999 panel — the dog under the table, unexplained — redrawn beside the 2009 dog under the table, explained by everything. Two panels side by side; the strip's first diptych.

panels.composition: Left half of a diptych: the 1999 panel, redrawn exactly — Era I's line, the print-shop table, a small dog under it, no explanation.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a small dog under a print-shop table drawn in scratchy 1990s zine style, no words
image.notes: Era I's line for this panel only. The Dog Monday panel (dw_1999-11).

panels.composition: Right half: 2009. The garage's drafting table. The dog under it, ten, gray at the muzzle, asleep. Era II's line.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, an old gray-muzzled dog asleep under a drafting table in a garage, no words

panels.composition: Wood's feet under the table, both panels' worth of years in the way he's sitting. The dog's chin on his foot.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man's feet under a drafting table with an old dog's chin resting on one of them, no words

panels.composition: The garage from the door. The table. The man. The dog beneath. Ten years. No caption.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a garage studio from its doorway with a man at a drafting table and an old dog asleep beneath it, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The diptych: 1999 beside 2009. Two lines on one strip.
